import unicodedata

def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    # Decompose Unicode characters to separate base letters from accents
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    # Keep only letters and digits, convert to lower case, ignore accents
    cleaned = ''.join(
        ch.lower() for ch in normalized
        if ch.isalnum()
    )
    # Compare cleaned string with its reverse
    return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]
